name: deployfix-lab-monorepo
description: DeployFix Lab — Full-Stack Production Deployment Troubleshooting Platform
author: Radhesh Bhuva <@Radheshbhuva>

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Application/backend install && npm --prefix Application/frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix Application/backend run build && npm --prefix Application/frontend run build
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix Application/backend run type-check && npm --prefix Application/frontend run type-check
scripts.test: npm --prefix Application/backend test && npm --prefix Application/frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix Application/backend run lint && npm --prefix Application/frontend run lint
